verdict.rationale: Runpod explicitly supports natural-language operation via its 'Agent Skills' plugin and official MCP servers, letting users ask an AI agent to 'create Pods, deploy Serverless endpoints, transfer files, or deploy your own code with Flash, all in natural language' (docs-12, docs-44), backed by documented MCP server integration (docs-3, docs-36, probe-3). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation that these natural-language flows work reliably in practice beyond first-party docs.
